$description: Select's tokens (plan 0006 §0s.6, inputs). The build generates styles/components/kinds/select.css and select.generated.ts from the select group. Only the open list (the content part) is styled here; it had no surface at all, so it showed whatever lay under it. The trigger and the root stay on the inline chain until their batch.

select.$description: Styles the open list. Each variant is a surface role read from the family in scope, as Popover's panel is; the default is elevated. The kind owns its radius and border width (the class map's rounded-md and border).
